title: Recovering after a loss or a bad session

D0.outcome: Explains why a loss or a bad session hurts the next session and what a recovery routine does.

D1.outcome: After a lost game, completes a three-step routine (one thing done well, one concrete error, one next action) instead of replaying the game or stopping.

D2.outcome: Returns to the next planned session after each of three losses.

D3.outcome: Spots signs of tilt and switches to review or stops.

misconceptions: Analyse the loss straight away, whatever the mood.
conditions: Rewards are evidence of capability, not streaks.
contrasts: A punitive streak counter that punishes a missed day.
Deep analysis of a loss while upset.
A win or an even session.
